title: Anthropic: AI narrowing gap between lone attackers and state hackers
summary: Anthropic case studies of Russian- and Chinese-linked operations from December to August showed AI letting small actors do more, with humans still choosing targets.

title: OpenAI opens Agents API exposing Codex's managed harness
summary: OpenAI released an Agents API public beta that manages sessions, tool coordination and recovery for developer-built agents.

title: Cohere releases 218B translation model covering 50 languages
summary: Canada's Cohere Labs released a 50-language translation MoE for non-commercial use, claiming it beats DeepL and Google in its tests.
